pages.text: As the river fell, it left many branches scattered on the bank. The three children came to collect them.
Mina gathered branches and tied them with a cord, making a bundle. "I'll make a big bundle for Sonu to carry!"
Sonu was slow, picking up a branch and putting it down again.
Mina went to Sonu's spot and quickly gathered the branches. Soon it was the biggest bundle.
Sonu arrived. A bundle was already tied in their place.
Sonu untied it and kicked the branches apart. "I wanted to collect them myself!"
Branches scattered everywhere. The biggest bundle was gone.
Mom looked at them. "Who collected this bundle?"
Mina chose only thin branches and gathered them before Sonu. Sonu picked them up one by one.
Three bundles lay in the yard. Sonu's was smallest. But Sonu had tied it all.
